issuanceMeaning: Actual research generation and immutable preservation; publication or production adoption is established separately

output.bandMeaning: Min/max of declared conditional scenarios; not a prediction interval

metadata.futureInnovationScale: Latest 90-day realized daily log-return standard deviation held constant; not an estimated future volatility forecast.
metadata.representativeRule: One seeded post-Merge historical-block residual path shared by the three economic conditions.
metadata.residualFormula: R[t] = exp(-ln(2)/730) * R[t-1] + standardized historical block return * latest 90-day daily sigma
